name: Royal Hospital
heroTitle: Caring for you, close to home.
heroText: Consultation, diagnostics and treatment under one roof in Unnikulam. Check department timings, then book your visit.
deptIntro: Everything you need in one place.

services.name: OP
services.text: Meet our doctors for consultation, check-ups and follow-up visits. Pick a department and a time that suits you, and we will confirm your booking.

services.name: Laboratory
services.text: Blood tests and other diagnostic tests, with clear and reliable reports that you and your doctor can act on.

services.name: Emergency care
services.text: First-line care for sudden illness and injury. If someone needs urgent help, call the hospital right away.

services.name: Pharmacy
services.text: Prescribed medicines available inside the hospital, so you can collect them right after your consultation.
